---
title: "Settings and shared services"
---

Settings is reserved for shared app-level controls and services. Capability-specific parameters belong to module-owned capability settings so they project consistently into direct runs and preset authoring.

## Current/shared service patterns

- ML Kit language model download/availability;
- output/export preferences;
- shared hardware/service controls;
- credentials for online services where appropriate;
- future shared resource packs such as offline map tiles.

## Fixed, runtime and operational inputs

A capability setting may be fixed by a preset, requested at runtime, or treated as an operational input. Preset authoring decides that policy without changing the canonical input name or semantics.
